name: Personal assistant session start
description: Reconstruct assistant context from durable artifacts and produce a startup briefing.

nodes.label: Load profile
nodes.description: Read the user profile and assistant operating expectations before interpreting any other context.

artifact.description: Notes on the user's working style, trust boundary, preferences, and assistant expectations.

nodes.label: Read operating policy
nodes.description: Read source, live-access, privacy, and persistence rules so the briefing does not overclaim what the harness checked.

artifact.description: Summary of allowed sources, live-access limits, and persistence expectations for this session.

nodes.label: Read continuity
nodes.description: Read the continuity brief as the base picture of current projects, open gates, and loose threads.

artifact.description: Compact summary of the continuity brief and any known stale areas to verify against recent sessions.

nodes.label: Inspect recent sessions
nodes.description: Read recent session notes and layer fresher corrections over the continuity brief.

artifact.description: Fresh facts, corrections, and next-session pointers from recent session notes.

nodes.label: Check open loops
nodes.description: Classify open loops into ready work, blocked work, waiting items, and decisions needing the user.

artifact.description: Open loop classification with blockers and recommended handling.

nodes.label: Synthesize briefing
nodes.description: Write a durable session-brief artifact with current picture, last session, open work, user-needed items, and recommended next step.

artifact.description: Startup briefing suitable for future recall without the transcript.

nodes.label: Decide next step
nodes.description: If a work target is clear, begin it; otherwise ask one concise question about what to work on next.

artifact.description: Chosen next action, user question, or handoff note derived from the briefing.
